audit.why: The packet's own defect note flags 'Bard wins 52.17% but the chart gives Lux 6/7 stages vs 0' as a contradiction, but this is not actually inconsistent: a lane Lux dominates through 6/first item does not preclude Bard's team winning 52.17% of games overall once late-game utility, roams, and objective play take over — content's own late-game text (whys[6], spikes[3]) describes exactly that swing back to skill/even. No correction needed to the win rate itself.
Content win[] (Lux x6, Skill) matches the packet levelChart: Lux's long root and ranged poke own laning through first item, and it comes back to skill late once she's caught without an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[1..5].side read 'Skill' but content win[1..5]='Lux' and the packet levelChart agrees — only phases[0] and phases[6] were ever updated to match content.
audit.why: Lux's Light Binding (Q) is a long root that hard-counters Bard's engage and sets up an E-Q-auto punish through level 5, with Final Spark making it lethal at 6 — content's whys already state this and match the packet.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1,2,3,4,5].side to 'Lux' with matching why rewrites; phases[0] and phases[6] already agreed with win[0] and win[6], so left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions are missing: Lux's W (Prismatic Barrier) absorbs burst — never stated; and her combo opens with a passive (Illumination) auto-attack reset, so the wind-up animation is the real tell, not the ability cast — also never stated.
audit.why: The kit flags confirm W as shield-type (absorbs burst, changes all-in math) and P as an auto-attack reset (burst timing tell).
audit.corrected: Worked the shield fact into tradeBad and the auto-reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns.
